workflows: Engagement Recognition Pipeline: Image Data + OpenFace Features -> Deep Learning Models (ResNet, EfficientNet) -> Predict Engagement Labels.
Enhancement Workflow: Action Units (from WACV Dataset) + Statistical Discriminant Coefficients (SDC) -> Mapped to Engagement Labels -> Enhance Machine Learning Models/Deep Learning Models.

Future Real-time Engagement Recognition Workflow: Real-time Video Data -> Temporal Deep Learning Techniques (LSTM Networks, TCNs) + Valence-Arousal Modeling -> Detect/Interpret Engagement Levels -> Applications (Online Education, Remote Work, Human-Computer Interaction).
integration_points: Integration of Temporal Deep Learning Techniques and Valence-Arousal Modeling into the existing framework for real-time video data processing.
